title: Offset for Loan File Suspensions in Rate Lock Commitment Extension Disputes
content:
### Suspensions of the loan file and Rate Lock Commitment extension relief

The borrower's own suspensions offset the relief on a disputed extension charge, because a file suspended for overdue conditions was held up by the borrower as well. The basis is the number of times the **Mortgage Loan File** has been resubmitted to underwriting from suspense.

**Rule.**

- When the loan file has been resubmitted from suspense two or more times, the repeat suspension offset of **2** days is subtracted from the relief days.
- When it has been resubmitted once, the suspension offset of **1** day is subtracted.
- Otherwise nothing is subtracted.

The relief days, after this subtraction, are never below zero and never more than the disputed extension's charged days.

| Resubmissions from suspense | Days subtracted |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

*Hypothetical case:* relief days that would otherwise be 1, on a file resubmitted twice, become 1 less 2. That is taken as 0, never below zero.
